<!-- Code generated by tools/plugin-prompts from plugins/prompt-source; DO NOT EDIT. -->

Use the `mark_fetch` MCP tool with `force: true` to fetch `/index.md` from the demarkus-memory server and render the full contents to the user. Only an explicit `not-found` means the index does not exist; say so and suggest populating it. For `unauthorized`, unreachable, transport, server, malformed-response, or other tool failures, surface the actual error and stop without suggesting population.
